column1: # The real run of bridge 0.161.0 on SOLIDWORKS (02/11/2026, notes 100 and 101), for RealRunContract.
# Made by stile_quote.py 1.5.0 «reale» from the answers of drawing_dimension (the arguments of the drawing run), view_edges of the same
# views and the owner's drawings measured by stile_quote.py. Sheet millimetres. call: the order of the calls on that
# drawing (one number per drawing_dimension); kind: between, or other (a dimension of another route: its text only).
# drawn: the box bridge 0.161.0 measured from (the lines of the view, or its outline when they could not be read);
# lines: the lines of the view, or the extent of its edges when they could not be read (what the bridge measures from now).
# bridge_*: where bridge 0.161.0 put the text, read back; owner_*: where the owner has it (empty when not matched).
